d1.text: One song. That's all the music gives us.

q1.text: Look. The prints go back out.

d2.text: They lead straight to Mira's booth.

q2.text: The awning's torn. Something heavy hit it.

d3.text: Patel. The awning broke his fall.

q3.text: The music stopped. Don't run. Walk.

m2.text: Dev. Thirteen-oh-seven. I know every tenant's face.

d4.text: Mira, the wet prints end at your back door.

m3.text: Look at the van first. The driver never gets out. Not once.

q4.text: Three knocks. That's how Patel collected rent.

m4.text: He was still talking when he came in.

d6.text: Mira... what did you lock in there?

end.text: Part eight. Would you open that door?
